binary_release_rules: Every route/state/viewport combination in the implementation test plan has a fresh same-size screenshot and DOM assertion.
No primary content horizontal overflow at 1440, 768, 390, 375, 320 CSS pixels, or 200% zoom.
No interactive control or content region is supplied by a raster screenshot.
Status has text and icon; focus remains visible; touch targets are at least 44 by 44 CSS pixels.
Unsupported or conditional coverage never renders a stale zoning, capacity, or underwriting result as current.
Reduced motion removes transforms and nonessential fades without removing information.
The mobile decision dock never clips the input placeholder, focused control, status, or primary action.
